critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingGuard at /app/frontend/src/app/[locale]/(authenticated)/layout.tsx is correctly implemented: uses useAuth() (SWR-backed, no extra round-trip), redirects via router.replace, shows spinner fallback with data-testid='onboarding-guard-redirect' during transition.

MINOR: Task description says 'h2 con id=card' but actual implementation puts id='card' on the wrapping <section> element (via Section helper at line 29-36 of design-system/page.tsx), with the h2 inside without id. Anchor navigation #card still works correctly because the SECTION has the id. Functional behaviour is correct; only the literal description in the task vs implementation differs. No action needed since requirement says 'h2 con id=card Y/O anchor #card lleva a una sección con ejemplos del componente Card' — second clause is satisfied.

NOTE: Seeded admin (admin@arroba.dev) has memberships=[] in current DB state. As a side effect of the new guard, admin cannot reach /internal/design-system without first creating an organization or completing onboarding. This is intentional per the code comment in layout.tsx line 13-14, but may surprise admins who only want DS access. Created an org POST /api/organizations to unblock; consider seeding an admin org in scripts/seed_admin.py for future tests.
